2607.11826.title: Transformer-Guided Swarm Intelligence for Frugal Neural Architecture Search
2607.11826.paper_summary: Neural Architecture Search (NAS) has automated the design of deep learning models but traditionally requires massive computational resources, often measured in thousands of GPU-days. In this paper, we propose a frugal and memetic NAS framework designed to democratize architecture design on consumer-grade hardware. Our approach combines the global macro-search capabilities of an autoregressive Transformer controller, trained via Reinforcement Learning (RL), with the local micro-exploitation of an Artificial Bee Colony (ABC) algorithm. To prevent premature convergence during the RL phase, we introduce a dynamic entropy mechanism that forces topological exploration upon detection of performance stagnation. Evaluated on a standard GPU (NVIDIA RTX 3060), our hybrid method effectively resolves the "cold-start" problem inherent in metaheuristics. By algorithmically penalizing network depth, our framework actively mitigates model bloat: on the CIFAR-10 dataset, it discovers an efficient architecture reaching 84.85% accuracy with only $\sim$174,000 parameters (significantly smaller than standard baselines like ResNet-20) in 3 hours of search time. Furthermore, we demonstrate the framework's flexibility by applying it to credit card fraud detection, directly optimizing the F1-Score on highly imbalanced tabular data to reach a F1-Score of 0.71 with a compact network of $\sim$4,600 parameters. These results suggest that our approach can yield tailored, accessible, and highly parameter-efficient deep learning models suitable for edge deployment.
2607.11826.paper_summary_zh: 神經架構搜尋（NAS）已經自動化了深度學習模型的設計，但傳統上需要大量的計算資源，通常以數千個 GPU 天來衡量。在本文中，我們提出了一個節約且具備模因特性的 NAS 框架，旨在使消費級硬體上的架構設計民主化。我們的方法結合了通過強化學習（RL）訓練的自回歸 Transformer 控制器的全球宏觀搜尋能力，與人工蜂群（ABC）算法的局部微觀開發能力。為了防止在 RL 階段的過早收斂，我們引入了一種動態熵機制，當檢測到性能停滯時，強制進行拓撲探索。在標準 GPU（NVIDIA RTX 3060）上進行評估，我們的混合方法有效解決了元啟發式算法固有的「冷啟動」問題。通過算法性地懲罰網絡深度，我們的框架主動減少模型膨脹：在 CIFAR-10 數據集上，它發現了一個高效的架構，達到 84.85% 的準確率，僅用約 174,000 個參數（顯著小於像 ResNet-20 這樣的標準基準），搜索時間為 3 小時。此外，我們通過將該框架應用於信用卡詐騙檢測，直接優化高度不平衡的表格數據上的 F1 分數，達到 0.71 的 F1 分數，並且使用了一個約 4,600 個參數的緊湊網絡。這些結果表明，我們的方法可以產生量身定制、可訪問且高度參數高效的深度學習模型，適合邊緣部署。
